card.name: Purpose links after handling steps
card.fires_on: The small linking word (to, so, allow, comma) right after a physical handling step, such as inverting a vial or raising a bag, where a purpose clause follows. Also fires on a few mid-word spots in long medical terms.

modes.label: Purpose link after handling
modes.description: A word like to, so or allow that introduces the goal after an instruction such as inverting, blinking or raising.
modes.example: Invert the vial and gently rotate<< to>> resuspend the microspheres.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Partway through a long drug or procedure term, such as peritoneal dialysis or quinidine.
